title: Updates
author: kaansengul
body_snippet:

3. Nightly: "Check failed!"
4. Github: "Latest version: 1.81.0"

Currently in "1.82.0-beta3 (Pre-release 3592) x64"

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks for the detailed report — the per-channel results were exactly what was needed to pin this down.

The root cause is that this fork distributes **only through GitHub Releases**, but three of the four channels were left over from the original upstream project:

- **Stable / Preview / Nightly** fetched plain-text files (`update.txt`, `preview-update.txt`, `nightly-update.txt`) from the old upstream website (`mremoteng.org`). That site still serves upstream's own `update.txt` — hence Stable r...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Follow-up: the update system has now been fully consolidated around the fix above, so the behaviour is consistent everywhere (not just the check endpoint).

**What the app does now**
- *Check for updates* queries this fork's latest GitHub release (`releases/latest` — the latest stable) and reports the version.
- The download button opens that release's page in your browser; there's no separate in‑app MSI download/verify/install step.
